exposure: ultrasound criteria for Morbidly Adherent Placenta (MAP)
outcome: extent of placental invasion (focal or diffuse)
vascularity of the lower uterine segment
cohort: Twenty-one pregnant women with a high possibility of placenta accreta.
finding: A customized 'pro forma' demonstrated satisfactory accuracy in predicting Morbidly Adherent Placenta cases, particularly those with anterior placenta previa or anterior low-lying placenta, with ultrasound signs significantly detecting the degree of placental invasion.
